rule: School-zone days: not a weekend, not a NSW public holiday, not a publicly notified government-school holiday. Pupil-free days inside term count (zones follow the official terms even if a school does not).
sources: Terms: Transport for NSW Speed Zones dataset, School Zones data, OP_CAL field (generated 2026-11-06), CC BY 4.0 -- https://opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au/data/dataset/speed-zones

Public holidays: NSW Guide to Public Holidays 2024-2026 (TfNSW 'School and public holidays' dataset, from industrialrelations.nsw.gov.au), CC BY -- https://opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au/data/dataset/school-and-public-holidays
